title: Full Local-54 best-available numeric maximisation
objective: Maximise defensible numeric coverage across every applicable Local-54 county, constituency and ward cell by systematically exhausting direct, derived, secondary, spatial, statistical small-area, temporal projection and constrained downscaling methods before retaining an unavailable disposition.

governing_policy.publication_presumption: Publish the best defensible value with truthful source-tier, method, period, confidence and uncertainty labels rather than omit merely because the value is non-primary or modelled.

method_classes.description: Direct local official observations, exact aggregation, official administrative records and deterministic derivations.
Credible secondary observations tied to identifiable primary evidence or independently corroborated evidence lineages.
Point-in-polygon, raster zonal statistics, network intersection and other reproducible geography-aware derivations.
Transparent survey small-area estimation using microdata and defensible covariates, with uncertainty and out-of-sample validation.
Projection of a known local observation to a later reference period using an explicit change model, never an unlabelled carry-forward.
Economic, agricultural or other modelled downscaling constrained to authoritative higher-level totals and validated against known observations.
Preferred value selected from conflicting defensible candidates under the existing P33 conflict policy, with alternatives retained.

feasibility_classes.A: Deterministic/direct path available or highly likely; execute first.
feasibility_classes.B: Reproducible spatial/administrative/secondary path available with bounded validation risk.
feasibility_classes.C: Statistical/modelled path feasible with uncertainty and hold-out/back-aggregation validation.
feasibility_classes.D: Projection/downscaling path potentially feasible but may publish only if indicator-specific validation thresholds are met.
feasibility_classes.E: Structurally inapplicable, definitionally incompatible, rights-blocked, or model fails validation; retain S6/S7 with evidence.

validation_framework: Deterministic derivations must reconcile to authoritative totals where the measure is additive.
Spatial methods must use an explicit boundary vintage and report unmatched or ambiguous source records.
S5 small-area models require uncertainty intervals and out-of-sample or hold-out validation where data permit.
Modelled child estimates must be back-aggregated to known higher-level observations and residual bias reported.
No universal accuracy threshold is assumed: each indicator family must declare and justify its publication threshold before model execution.
A method that fails its declared validation gate cannot publish merely to increase coverage.

coverage_kpis.definition: Share of applicable cells with S0 direct or S1 official-derived numeric values.
Share of applicable cells with any defensible S0-S5 numeric value; this is the principal P42 product-coverage KPI.
Share of published numeric cells that rely on S5 modelled/projected estimates.
Share of S4/S5 published values carrying the required confidence/interval or uncertainty metadata.
Applicable cells still at S6 after every approved method path has been adjudicated.

public_product_requirements: Default profile view may show the best available S0-S5 value for an applicable indicator.
Users must be able to switch to an Official/observed-only view that excludes modelled/secondary values as defined by the product policy.
Every S2-S5 value must display a distinct source-tier/method label and expose period, source inputs, confidence/uncertainty and methodology.
Estimated/modelled values must never be visually indistinguishable from direct official values.
Indicators with ranking_allowed=false remain non-rankable regardless of numeric availability; modelled values may not silently enable prohibited rankings.
outputs: data/p42/numeric-maximisation-matrix.json covering all 54 indicators at county/constituency/ward level
machine-readable method/source feasibility and expected-yield assessment for every applicable non-numeric cell
reusable derivation/modelling engines with deterministic inputs and validation artifacts
updated candidate/preferred observations and Local-54 slot ledger carrying S0-S5 values
public Best available versus Official/observed-only control with methodology and uncertainty disclosure
indicator-family validation reports including reconciliation, hold-out/back-aggregation performance and publication decisions
acceptance: All 54 indicators are explicitly assessed at county, constituency and ward level, subject to applicability, against every relevant permitted method class.
Every applicable non-numeric cell is assigned a concrete executable method path or an evidence-backed reason why all permitted paths are infeasible or failed validation.
No applicable cell remains S6 solely because no direct local official table exists when a defensible S1-S5 method passes the indicator-specific validation gate.

Every A and B feasibility opportunity is executed; every C opportunity is either executed and validated or retained unavailable with recorded model-validation evidence; D opportunities publish only when their predeclared validation thresholds are met.
Best-available numeric coverage increases above the P41 closing baseline; the exact cell gain and percentage-point gain are reported separately from direct/official-derived coverage.
All S4/S5 published values carry method, period, boundary vintage, source inputs, confidence/uncertainty and validation metadata.
Zero values use arbitrary equal splitting, unlabelled parent-value inheritance, force-matched boundaries, invented precision or unsupported proxy substitution.
Deterministic additive measures reconcile where meaningful and modelled estimates report higher-level back-aggregation error/bias.
The public product distinguishes best-available from official/observed-only values and does not visually imply that estimated values are official observations.
Full Local-54, geography, browser, accessibility, release and GitHub Pages gates pass after the expanded numeric surface is published.
